targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at)) AS time,
  h.host_name AS metric,
  COUNT(tr.id) AS tests_executed
FROM test_runs r
JOIN test_results tr ON tr.run_id = r.run_id
JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id
JOIN tests t ON t.id = tr.test_id
WHERE COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at) BETWEEN
  CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30')
  AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30')
  AND ('${suite}' = '' OR t.test_suite = ${suite:sqlstring})
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(h.host_name, '${host:csv}') > 0)
GROUP BY r.run_id, h.host_name, r.finished_at, r.started_at
ORDER BY COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at);

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at)) AS time,
  h.host_name AS metric,
  COUNT(tr.id) AS tests_failed
FROM test_runs r
JOIN test_results tr ON tr.run_id = r.run_id
JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id
JOIN tests t ON t.id = tr.test_id
WHERE COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at) BETWEEN
  CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30')
  AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30')
  AND ('${suite}' = '' OR t.test_suite = ${suite:sqlstring})
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(h.host_name, '${host:csv}') > 0)
  AND tr.status = 'fail'
GROUP BY r.run_id, h.host_name, r.finished_at, r.started_at
ORDER BY COALESCE(r.finished_at, r.started_at);

SELECT
  r.run_id,
  DATE_FORMAT(r.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS started_at,
  COUNT(tr.id) AS tests_executed,
  ROUND(AVG(tr.duration_ms), 2) AS avg_test_duration_ms
FROM test_runs r
JOIN test_results tr ON tr.run_id = r.run_id
JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id
JOIN tests t ON t.id = tr.test_id
WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN
  CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30')
  AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30')
  AND ('${suite}' = '' OR t.test_suite = ${suite:sqlstring})
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(h.host_name, '${host:csv}') > 0)
GROUP BY r.run_id, r.started_at
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC;

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT t.test_suite AS __value, t.test_suite AS __text FROM tests t JOIN test_results tr ON tr.test_id = t.id JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE t.test_suite IS NOT NULL AND t.test_suite <> '' AND r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+05:30') ORDER BY t.test_suite
